title: Rav Acha of Bei Chozai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A precious homily of his is recorded in [Gittin 7a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.7a.12): “Whoever has a grievance against his fellow over food and keeps silent, He who dwells in the bush executes judgment for him.” But Rav Sherira Gaon’s reading in [his Epistle](https://www.sefaria.org/Epistle_of_Rav_Sherira_Gaon.1.81), part 2, end of chapter 4, is Rav Acha of Bei Chatim. Hyman identifies him as one of the Savoraim.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara calls him Rav Acha of Bei Chozai. Rav Sherira gives Bei Chatim and includes him among the Savoraim. Hyman cites the end of part 2, chapter 4. The linked digital edition places the passage at 1:81.
